offering_description.value: Provides consulting, engineering, design, project and program management, and construction management services. Clients are governments and private companies in infrastructure, water, environmental, advanced facilities and energy sectors. Delivered by project teams of engineers, scientists and technologists.

primary_services.value: engineering and design; project and program management; construction management; environmental and water consulting; advisory and technology consulting

customer_segment.value: B2G: federal, state and local agencies, transportation authorities, defense and space agencies, municipal water utilities; B2B: semiconductor, life sciences, energy, industrial and utility companies

end_markets.value: transportation infrastructure; water; environmental; advanced manufacturing (semiconductors, life sciences); energy and power; defense and space

revenue_model.value: service fees: professional services billed on time-and-materials or cost-plus bases; project or contract: fixed-price and long-term contracts for design, program and construction management

value_chain_position.value: service provider: engineering and project delivery expertise sold to public agencies and private corporations

geography_served.value: global: United States, United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, Middle East, Asia and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: infrastructure and advanced facilities, water, environmental, and energy consulting and engineering services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: competitive bids, framework contracts and long-term relationships with government and corporate clients

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: government contracting rules, professional engineering licensing, and safety and environmental standards
